gloss: recitation from memory; reciting by heart

definitions.gloss: recitation from memory; reciting by heart
definitions.explanation: Speaking or performing a text, poem, or passage from memory without looking at the original. Common in educational settings.

examples.japanese: {詩|し}を{暗唱|あんしょう}する。
examples.english: To recite a poem from memory.

examples.japanese: {英語|えいご}のスピーチを{暗唱|あんしょう}して{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: I memorized and delivered the English speech.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}に{覚|おぼ}えた{百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}を{今|いま}でも{暗唱|あんしょう}できる。
examples.english: I can still recite from memory the Hundred Poems I learned as a child.

notes:
Also written as {暗誦|あんしょう} with the same meaning. The kanji {唱|しょう} means to chant or recite, while {暗|あん} means from memory (without looking).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {詩|し}を{暗唱|あんしょう}する (to recite a poem by heart)
- {暗唱|あんしょう}テスト (recitation test)
- {暗唱|あんしょう}できる (to be able to recite from memory)
- すらすら{暗唱|あんしょう}する (to recite fluently from memory)

USAGE NOTE:
Common in Japanese schools, where students are sometimes asked to memorize and recite passages from textbooks, poems, or classical literature. Distinct from {朗読|ろうどく} (reading aloud), which involves reading from a text.
